usedFor: Planyo Online Booking holds reservations, Google Drive holds files, and “New Reservation” can start “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Reservation” in Planyo Online Booking, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new reservation makes a file reachable by link with Viewer, Commenter or Editor access.

watchOut: Anyone with the link gets the access level you pick, so use “Share File With Anyone” only on shareable files.
